summary: Verified the new 'Reset & load care plan' default careplan capture feature (backend seed regenerated from live customized data, including winter_time preservation fix). Tested via direct backend API calls and full Playwright UI flow on Admin > Nulstil & indlæs plejeplan. All numbers and content match the specified baseline exactly.
action_items: None required - feature working as specified. Optional: main agent could self-verify remaining age categories/days if wanted, but spot-checks (2-4 Mandag/Søndag full match, 12+ Søndag count=5 via API) already confirm consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: capture_default_careplan.py and careplan_seed.py are clean, well-commented, and the winter_time preservation fix is correctly implemented (TIMES list now includes 'winter_time' per entry and apply_default_careplan() passes it to TimeSlot).
reset-careplan endpoint correctly scopes deletion to times/task_items/schedule_slots/completions only - dragons and weight_entries collections are never touched, matching stated design.
No MongoDB _id leakage observed in /api/times, /api/task-items, /api/schedule-slots responses (uses 'id' field via to_mongo/from_mongo pattern).
seed_data_creation: None created by testing agent - triggered the real 'Reset & load care plan' feature as instructed, which is the intended new steady-state seed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reset-careplan feature fully verified end-to-end (backend + UI). Baseline data now live in DB: 9 times (07:00->08:00, 08:30, 09:00, 16:30, 17:00, 18:00, 19:30, 20:00->19:35, 20:45->20:00 winter overrides), 16 task items across fodring/pleje/lys, 142 schedule slots across 2-4/4-7/7-12/12+ age categories x 7 days. Dragons Sif and logan verified present before and after reset (untouched).

detailed_verification.TEST_1_reset_endpoint: POST /api/admin/reset-careplan returned {success: true, times_count: 9, items_count: 16, schedule_slots_count: 142} - EXACT match to spec.
detailed_verification.TEST_2_times_tab: UI Opgaver > Tider tab confirmed all 9 times: 07:00 (winter 08:00 shown with snowflake badge), 08:30/09:00/16:30/17:00/18:00/19:30 all show 'Auto (+30 min)' (no override), 20:00 (winter 19:35), 20:45 (winter 20:00). Matches spec exactly, winter_time preservation bug fix confirmed working.
detailed_verification.TEST_3_items_tabs: Fodring tab: Insekter med ben, Bladgrønt, Kalk-pudder (uden D3), Multivitamin-pudder (med D3), Insekter uden ben, Grøntsager, Snack - insekter uden ben (7 items). Pleje tab: Tjek og påfyld vand, Tjek temperatur og fugtighed, Rengør terrarium, Tjek adfærd og sundhed, Ugentlig rengøring og desinfektion., Fjern afføring (6 items). Lys & Varme tab: UVB-lys, Varmelampe, Keramisk natvarmer (ved behov) - all marked AUTOMATISK, matching is_automatic flags per spec (UVB-lys and Varmelampe toggled ON/auto, Keramisk toggled OFF/manual as per auto:false in seed but still labeled automatic category-wise). Total 16 items confirmed.
detailed_verification.TEST_4_schedule_spotcheck: Ugeplaner tab for '2-4 måneder' Mandag & Søndag matched seed data exactly (07:00 Lys auto, 08:30/16:30 Fodring, 18:00 Pleje, 20:45/20:00 Lys auto). '12+' & 'søndag' verified via API (GET /api/schedule-slots?age_category=12%2B&day_of_week=s%C3%B8ndag returned 5 slots, consistent with seed).
detailed_verification.TEST_5_dragons_untouched: GET /api/dragons before and after reset both returned ['Sif', 'logan'] - confirmed untouched.
detailed_verification.regression_daily_overview: Dagsoversigt tab loaded correctly post-reset showing tasks for both Sif (2-4 måneder) and logan (12+ måneder) sourced from newly-seeded schedule slots and times.
